limits: Triage only. The model ranks commands by how much they look like past commands the denylist blocked. It does not verify anything.
The denylist (server.check_dangerous) stays the only gate. A low score never means a command is safe, and this model must never be used to bypass, weaken, or replace the denylist.

Label skew: the training set is 69% blocked / 31% allowed (571 blocked / 253 allowed of 824 commands). Accuracy near the majority baseline means the model learned nothing; judge it by minority-class recall and ROC AUC instead.
Commands using constructs unseen in training fall into the OTHER bucket; the model has no opinion about them beyond the generic token/operator features.
